desc: Derive the marginal-cost threshold approach and exact handling of boundary ties.
Derive per-product formulas for counting marginal costs and summing their costs.
Establish and implement a universally valid binary-search upper bound.
Implement the stdin/stdout Python solution with integer arithmetic.
Verify edge cases including all prices greater than `2M+1`, equal prices, small budgets, threshold gaps, and large values.
Assess the final algorithm’s complexity and Python performance under `N = 2 × 10^5`.
